commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Someone waits until others have gone and then speaks ill of them. The earth seems to carry that body thinking, “To bear this cruel thing is my righteousness.” It bears everything by nature, but this is hard to bear, so he says it does so for righteousness’ sake.
